new_meta.description: Automatique (xe ga) ou semi-automatique (xe số) : prise en main, trafic de Hanoi, descentes, permis et test de dix minutes pour choisir votre moto de location.

evidence.FACTS: Removed the invented learning-time claims ('une matinée', 'quatre gestes', 'des générations de conducteurs l'ont apprise') and replaced them by the hub wording (courte séance dans une rue calme pour les gestes de base, quelques jours pour le réflexe), consistent with /types-motos/semi-automatique/. Removed 'dépôt, contrat écrit' policy hints. Prices from the owner table with the mandatory disclaimer: semi-automatic 150 000-200 000 / 700 000-800 000 / 1 000 000-1 200 000 VND, automatic scooter 150 000-200 000 / 600 000-1 000 000 / 1 200 000-2 000 000 VND, no derived package, no availability claim. Licence: A1 <=125 cm3 or 11 kW / A above under Law 36/2024/QH15 (in force 1 Jan 2025), cited inline to hcc.nghean.gov.vn (seen in search result 2026-10-29, secondary source), with the explicit point that category depends on cylinder capacity and not on transmission, and that the visitor's own licence depends on country/category/IDP. Model families (Wave, Sirius) mentioned as examples of widespread mechanics without a disponibility claim. Vocabulary xe ga / xe số as in the hub pages. No spec figure.
evidence.INTENT: Main question: which of the two transmissions is easier. Owner (own URL). Distinct from /types-motos/automatique-ou-semi-automatique-mensuelle-location-hanoi/ (one-month stay: daily use, maintenance, monthly price) and /types-motos/scooter-ou-semi-automatique-ninh-binh/ (one excursion) and /hanoi/semi-automatique-moto-routes-hanoi/ (routes) because this page compares ease of handling and learning in general; it links to the monthly guide for the long-stay angle.
evidence.CONTENT: Full rewrite of mannered prose ('le match', 'quatre gests', 'compagnon', 'la boîte apprend', 'zéro-apprentissage', 'gymnastique'). New: situation table; what each transmission asks (commands, vocabulary, difference with a manual-clutch bike); a four-step learning routine with common mistakes and the centrifugal-clutch behaviour; Hanoi traffic; outside the city (descents, wheels, repair, luggage); duration and indicative prices; licence rule; 10-minute test; 5 FAQ. Words 1635 -> 1693.
evidence.META: Title shortened to match the H1 meaning and drop the vague 'quelle moto est plus facile' wording (65 chars). H1 kept (it is the anchor text used on the hub). Description rewritten (159 chars). og tags identical to title/description. Eyebrow 'Transmission · prise en main'. The cluster matrix title/H1 will differ from the page for title only (sync required).

Dropped /types-motos/50cc/. No broken link per checker.
